deleteProject.label: Delete project?
deleteProject.full: “{name}” contains {content}. Everything in it will be deleted, with its variables and saved passwords. Open connections are closed. This cannot be undone.
deleteProject.empty: “{name}” is empty. It will be deleted with its variables. This cannot be undone.

deleteCollection.label: Delete collection?
deleteCollection.full: “{name}” contains {content}. They will all be deleted, with their saved passwords. Open connections to these hosts are closed. This cannot be undone. To keep the hosts, move them out first.

deleteHost.label: Delete host?
deleteHost.content: “{name}” and its saved passwords will be deleted. Open connections to it are closed.

actions.tabs: {count, plural, one {# open tab} other {# open tabs}} will be closed.
actions.unsaved: Unsaved changes in {names} will be lost.
